manifest.source: torchvision datasets (MD5-verified archives), ResNet-18 ImageNet embeddings; attacks applied to raw pixels
manifest.policy: External attacks (BackdoorBench), not written by the detector's author. Detector frozen at git commit 722925d; no tuning on these results; run and quoted once. Original rules: never edit this file in place.
manifest.change: adds the within-class signature check 'sig' (clean-label triggers; penalty 1.3, row gate 2.3), chosen on dev: research/mm/classsig_study_dev.py and research/mm/combine_study_dev.py
